What’s New Backstage Log In Sign Up Newsletter Sign Up Find a Dealer × OD-1X Overdrive Where to Buy --> Home Effects Pedals Distortion/Overdrive/Fuzz OD-1X Home OD-1X Features Specs Articles --> Articles Accessories --> Accessories Downloads --> Downloads Support Plug Into the Ultimate Overdrive Experience The OD-1X launches the classic BOSS overdrive into a new era of expression, delivering unmatched performance for guitarists seeking the ultimate tone. This advanced stomp combines decades of pedal expertise with the latest technologies, bringing you a breakthrough sound experience that’s only possible with BOSS innovation. Prepare to be amazed—the inspiring and ultra-responsive OD-1X will change your thinking about overdrive pedals forever. View the Gallery Introduction Movie Features Advanced overdrive pedal with next-level sound, feel, and tonal response BOSS’s innovative MDP technology and high-speed DSP deliver a superior playing experience that’s unattainable with analog overdrive circuits Powerful real-time processing provides wide-ranging drive sounds with rich harmonics and natural compression Bold, high-definition tone that’s also smooth and refined Preserves the unique tonal characteristics of different guitars and pickups Very low noise, even with high-gain settings Drive, High, and Low knobs control multiple internal parameters at once, providing sophisticated sound shaping not available in typical pedals Striking appearance with exclusive chrome knobs and control plate, plus vintage silver knob for battery compartment access BOSS five-year warranty Natural Overdrive Realized with Advanced BOSS Technology Backed by our MDP engine, the OD-1X dishes up loads of refined overdrive sounds that smoothly integrate with nearly any amp platform. At every gain setting, you get lively tones that are punchy, articulate, and satisfying. From light edge-of-breakup body and fat rhythm crunch to mid-boosted gain for singing leads, it’s all there in one versatile and highly musical pedal. Hear Your Guitar’s Real Voice Guitarists spend a lot of time choosing instruments and pickup configurations for different styles. Our sophisticated MDP process enhances your fundamental tone, providing transparent performance that allows the guitar’s true character to shine through. The OD-1X sound is natural and open, letting you hear the unique elements of body construction, pickup types, string gauges, and playing techniques.
